name: Deepworks winch, pulley and inner bar
notes: The wiring of the Deepworks blockout (scene deepworks, mw-e26.2). The winch lever inside the winch house and the shootable winch pulley over the cage bay both call the cage down: a latch keeps it down and opens the cage lift's gate (cage-gate, onto the shaft to the silver level) and the cage bay's gate (cage-bay-gate, the winch-cage way in from the forecourt). The inner-bar lever, which a sorcerer can pull from range through the slit, raises the inner-bar portcullis. Binding names are the scene's spawn ids. The player-filtered volume mine-gate is the main quest area mine-gate (follow-tansy, mw-sba): the boarded forecourt in front of the gate wall, around the mine-gate marker spawn, reached by the mine road from Market Green. The quest reads it, so it is not wired. The player-filtered volume weeping-adit is the arrival of the Weeping Adit across the flooded gallery, around adit-arrival (mw-heoa; the rumour book's visit trigger of place-weeping-adit).
